notes.title: STAR-M game is officially released!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=JdEtWd131ec;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
STAR - M is not only a stand-alone third-person game, but also a simulated multiplayer cooperative combat game. You can play a large-scale multiplayer cooperative combat game without the need for an internet connection. At the same time, you can use the 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 shortcut keys to switch roles at will. The tight combat rhythm, intense plot, high-quality and gorgeous scenes create a refreshing game experience! There are no excessive tasks, no complicated routine upgrades, no extra plots, no additional payment fees, automatic reloading, and V/B keys can be used to increase the health of a single or all players in a multiplayer cooperative combat scene. It is a high-quality third-person shooting game tailored for players who like shooting games. The opponents include boxers, swordsmen, biochemical warriors, space soldiers, robots, etc. The environment includes various different cabins inside spaceships, alien bases and other scenes. There will be other types of updates in the future. Please experience the STAR - M game! ! !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997790/ef3a3893a3c0447d4a109fbac156395f79c00ce7.jpg[/img]

Support 12 languages ​​at the same time!!!
English, Chinese, French, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, German, Italian, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Mongolian.

notes.title: Star - M early access version 0.1.5
notes.content:
Welcome players to Star-M Games and tell us what you think!

The early access version is an independent game and may contain some minor bugs. The game is initially designed as a multiplayer online, multiplayer, open, and free experience game. If you like it, you are welcome to express your thoughts, your opinions on the future design and gameplay of the game, etc. We will actively refer to the opinions of players!
